Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. TOP LEFT — smash-and-grab (n.砸窗户抢劫): A shop display window is shattered and a jewelry tray is empty, a fleeing generic silhouette in the distance; aftermath only, no method detail.
TOP RIGHT — arcade (n.有拱廊的街道(两旁常设商店)): A small covered street with three repeated stone arches and compact shopfronts beneath them, clear pedestrian arcade.
BOTTOM LEFT — Piccadilly (n.皮卡迪利大街（伦敦市中心一条著名的街道）): A London street vignette with curved classical shopfronts, a red double-decker bus and an Eros-like fountain silhouette; no readable names.
